exposure: trial of labour after one previous lower segment caesarean section (TOLAC)
cohort: 385 women who underwent a TOLAC from 2010 to 2012 in a regional UK obstetric unit
finding: The Smith et al. and Grobman et al. models were statistically reliable in predicting successful vaginal birth after a previous cesarean section.
mod_finding: The Smith et al. and Grobman et al. models were validated as potentially useful tools for predicting successful vaginal birth after cesarean section in a UK population.
